name: Exp_HullTrend
summary: This EA trades based on the HullTrend custom indicator, which uses a Hull Moving Average to determine trend direction. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. The EA includes money management options and separate controls for opening and closing positions on each side.
summary_zh: 该EA基于HullTrend自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用Hull移动平均线判断趋势方向。当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损止盈。EA包含资金管理选项以及对多空双方开仓和平仓的独立控制。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Hull移动平均线的趋势跟踪，Hull MA通过加权移动平均的平方根周期来减少滞后性，从而更灵敏地捕捉趋势转折。入场条件为：当指标线Ind上穿信号线Sign时触发买入信号（BUY_Open），当Ind下穿Sign时触发卖出信号（SELL_Open），交叉确认需要两个连续K线的指标关系变化。出场条件包括：当趋势反转信号出现时平仓（BUY_Close/SELL_Close），以及固定的止损（StopLoss_=1000点）和止盈（TakeProfit_=2000点）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制仓位比例，MMMode枚举支持自由保证金、余额、亏损保证金、亏损余额和固定手数五种模式。资金管理集成了TradeAlgorithms.mqh库的标准化函数，提供多种资金管理计算方式。EA在每根新K线开盘时检测信号，避免逐tick重复交易，使用IsNewBar机制进行信号刷新。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on Hull Moving Average trend following, where Hull MA reduces lag by using a square-root period of weighted moving averages, making it more responsive to trend reversals. Entry conditions are: a buy signal (BUY_Open) triggers when the indicator line Ind crosses above the signal line Sign, and a sell signal (SELL_Open) triggers when Ind crosses below Sign, requiring a relationship change between two consecutive bars for crossover confirmation. Exit conditions include: closing positions on trend reversal signals (BUY_Close/SELL_Close), plus fixed stop loss (StopLoss_=1000 points) and take profit (TakeProfit_=2000 points). Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter with the MMMode enumeration supporting five modes: free margin, balance, loss-free margin, loss balance, and fixed lot. Money management integrates the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library's standardized functions providing multiple capital allocation calculation methods. The EA detects signals only on new bar openings to avoid per-tick repeated trading, using the IsNewBar mechanism for signal refresh.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金分配比例（占可用资金的百分比）

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算模式（自由保证金/余额/亏损保证金/亏损余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode (Free Margin/Balance/Net Margin Loss/Net Balance Loss/Fixed Lot)

pros: 基于Hull MA的趋势跟踪策略具有较低的滞后性，能更快速地响应趋势变化
提供了5种资金管理模式和灵活的仓位控制，适应不同风险偏好
多空方向的开仓和平仓可独立开关控制，策略配置灵活度高
使用新K线检测机制避免逐tick重复交易，减少了不必要的交易操作
止损止盈设置完备，且支持滑点控制，基本风险控制到位
pros_en: Hull MA-based trend following has lower lag, responding more quickly to trend changes
Provides 5 money management modes and flexible position sizing for different risk preferences
Independent on/off controls for buy/sell opening and closing offer high configuration flexibility
New bar detection mechanism prevents per-tick repeated trading, reducing unnecessary operations
Complete stop loss/take profit setup with slippage control provides basic risk management
cons: 固定止损1000点和止盈2000点未考虑市场波动性（ATR），在不同品种和周期下可能不适用
缺乏趋势过滤机制，在震荡行情中可能频繁产生虚假交叉信号导致连续亏损
没有追踪止损功能，盈利头寸可能在趋势回撤时大幅回吐利润
依赖自定义指标HullTrend，若指标文件缺失则EA无法运行，可移植性较差
未对已持仓方向进行检测，可能在同方向已持仓时重复开仓
cons_en: Fixed SL/TP of 1000/2000 points ignores market volatility (ATR), may be unsuitable across instruments and timeframes
Lacks trend filter mechanism, may generate frequent false crossover signals in ranging markets causing consecutive losses
No trailing stop feature, profitable positions may give back significant profits on trend pullbacks
Depends on custom HullTrend indicator; EA fails if indicator file is missing, reducing portability
No check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially opening duplicate positions
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动性自动调整止损止盈距离
加入趋势强度过滤（如ADX）或更高周期趋势确认，减少震荡行情中的虚假信号
增加追踪止损功能，在趋势运行中保护已有利润
添加同方向持仓检测，避免重复开仓增加风险敞口
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic SL/TP to automatically adjust stop distances based on market volatility
Add trend strength filter (e.g., ADX) or higher timeframe trend confirmation to reduce false signals in ranging markets
Add trailing stop functionality to protect profits during trend continuation
Add same-direction position check to prevent duplicate entries that increase risk exposure

risk_points: 固定止损止盈未适配不同市场波动环境，在高波动品种上止损可能过小
缺乏震荡行情过滤，可能在区间市场中频繁进出造成连续亏损
未检测同方向已有持仓，存在重复开仓风险
risk_points_en: Fixed SL/TP not adapted to different market volatility environments; stop loss may be too small on volatile instruments
Lacks ranging market filter, may cause frequent whipsaw entries and consecutive losses in sideways markets
No existing same-direction position check, risking duplicate position opening
